{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(data))
print("Number of duplicates:", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_with_neg999 = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print("Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999:", len(df_with_neg999))"}
